stem_book: Let z̄ denote the complex conjugate of a complex number z and let i = √−1. In the set of complex numbers, the number of distinct roots of the equation z̄ − z² = i(z̄ + z²) is ______. [JEE Advanced 2022 Paper-1]
reason: Stem cleaned of transcription junk only.
work: z̄(1 − i) = z²(1 + i) ⇒ z̄ = iz² ⇒ z = 0 or |z| = 1, then 1/z = iz² ⇒ z³ = −i (3 roots) ⇒ 4
